info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Enterprise Service By Procurement Id-spec
info.description: The Enterprise Service Retrieval API facilitates the access of enterprise service details associated with a specific procurement ID. This endpoint allows consumers, such as financial institutions and internal systems, to efficiently retrieve relevant service information, ensuring informed decision-making and compliance in procurement processes. By utilizing this API, users can streamline their service management and enhance operational oversight related to procurement activities. This resource is essential for integrating procurement data with enterprise service management workflows.

get.description: Fetches detailed information about a specific procurement resource identified by RES-100045. This endpoint provides all relevant data associated with the procurement, allowing developers to integrate or display the information effectively.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses the Bearer authentication mechanism, where the authentication information is transmitted as a bearer token. The token should be a JSON Web Token (JWT) which provides a compact and self-contained way for securely transmitting information between parties as a JSON object.
